# Delivery and remaining verification

## Implemented locally

- Single `homepod_sensor_link` integration, no legacy compatibility/transitions/migration.
- Discovery, existing native adoption and owned sensors for new devices.
- Local administrator credential UI for selected CSV/JSON or explicit controller fields; derived keys, trusted pins and bounded read-only matching.
- Dedicated User controller journals persisted before pairing changes, partial results, restart inspection, explicit Resume and cancellation.
- One integration entry with per-device policies, recovery on by default, administrator retention only while needed.
- Working recovery safeguards and v1.1.1 cleanup classification/cancellation regression preserved.
- Actual sensor-publication verification, stable private identities and fail-closed public/admin pin checks.
- Automatic per-device/integration credential/history cleanup without native-entry changes or accessory revocation.
- Single-component scanned packaging, read-only CI and offline HA matrix.
- Exact 100% Python/JavaScript coverage, strict typing, upstream hassfest, translated actions/entities/Repairs, same-pin reauth and dynamic selected-device updates.
- All 54 quality-rule targets and explicit Platinum/release readiness gates; no awarded-tier claim.

## Required before supported release claims

- Prove a protection-preserving extraction workflow on a named macOS/iOS/backup/application combination. The source-researched GUI backup path is currently a candidate; binary or missing records are not usable credentials.
- Separately authorise device testing through the existing 1Password workflow. Verify User access, fresh readings, unchanged Apple Home records, cancellation/ambiguous-write/restart safety and recovery on supported firmware.
- Recover original development provenance for `2d5e069` if available. Current publication preserves the existing GitHub history and scans files/index/reachable commits; that does not authenticate the missing earlier baseline.
- Keep the verified hosted CI and Codecov reporting healthy. Establish private security reporting and verify supported-release and HACS/branding requirements separately. Repository hosting is not acceptance or hardware verification.

## Deliberate boundaries

No setup-code shortcut, implicit keychain access, SIP/AMFI changes, native storage edits, silent Admin escalation, credential rotation or controller revocation is implemented. Removing/re-adding intentionally resets local repair history. The cause of pairing removal remains unproven.
